name: PI Industries Ltd
title: PI Industries Ltd - 523642 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue ₹15,652m rose sequentially, FY26 ₹67,137m with 25% EBITDA; capex ₹1,100 crore and asset turns fell from ~2.5x to ~1.5x, but management gave no volume or margin guidance beyond "growth for sure".

capex.quote: we should have INR 700 to INR 800 crore of capex both at the manufacturing level

triggers.label: Asset turns ~2.5x → ~1.5x
triggers.quote: the asset turns, which used to be almost like 2.5x, they have dropped down to almost like 1.5x now

triggers.label: FY27 growth only 'growth for sure'
triggers.quote: I would say growth for sure. Double or late single will all be subject to how the world reacts.

triggers.label: Export realisation down ~5%, pricing corrections
triggers.quote: there are pricing corrections , currency deviations that you know, we have pass through models.

triggers.label: Worst-case growth late single digit
triggers.quote: we can definitely look at growth, at nearly late-stage single digit or early-stage double digit at the worst-case scenario.

guidance.value: growth; worst case late single digit to early double digit
guidance.quote: we can definitely look at growth, at nearly late-stage single digit or early-stage double digit at the worst-case scenario.
we continue to focus to maintain the gross margin at that level.
we should have INR 700 to INR 800 crore of capex both at the manufacturing level
We expect FY27 and thereafter ETR to inch upto 24%.
achieving a INR 500 crore – INR 600 crore top line is when you would see these things move into a positive phase.
Five-six years is the estimate about somewhere about $ 80 million to $ 100 million of revenue in this space.
we will be remaining within this range from what we have estimated for today.

prior_guidance_check.quote: delivering sequential growth as per our guidance given last quarter
we delivered what we committed at the start of the year a resilient margin of 25% for full year
what was expected to turn around and outcomes we were looking at second quarter, second half, but still not come around.
